_comment: Physical and numerical constraints for the single-site NO2 pair potential. Values marked 'approx' must be checked against primary literature before being quoted.

bond_length_NN_A.note: N-N distance in N2O4 (approx. 1.78 A); default bead-bead bond length, as in the explorer

bond_length_COM_A.note: approx. distance between the NO2 centres of mass in planar N2O4 (N-N + 2 x 0.33 A); alternative bead definition

NN_stretch_wavenumber_cm1.note: approx. N-N stretching fundamental of N2O4; with mu = 23.0 g/mol it gives k_b ~ 580 kJ/mol/A^2

NO2_rotational_constants_cm1.note: approx. A, B, C of NO2 (NIST CCCBDB). The patch (C2 axis) librates about the a axis (in plane, perpendicular to C2; I_A = 16.858/A amu A^2) and the c axis (out of plane, I_C); used only for the Kern-Frenkel libration period
